# Third-party notices

## Cobe 2.0.1

`cobe.js` is a vendored copy of Cobe 2.0.1 by Shu Ding and contributors.
It is distributed under the MIT License.

Source: https://github.com/shuding/cobe
License: https://github.com/shuding/cobe/blob/main/LICENSE

The copy is kept in this repository so the VulnAssess viewer does not need an
external package installation, CDN request, React build chain, or Tailwind setup.

## Instrument Sans 5.3.0

`fonts/InstrumentSans-Variable.woff2` and
`fonts/InstrumentSans-VariableItalic.woff2` are vendored copies of Instrument
Sans by Instrument. `fonts/GeistMono-Variable.woff2` is a vendored copy of Geist
Mono by Vercel. Both are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Sources: https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-sans and https://github.com/vercel/geist-font
License: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/

The local font files avoid a font CDN or package installation when the viewer is
cloned and run on another machine.
